data.one_liner: Custom elevated button with gradient background and theme support
data.what_it_does: Provides a GradientElevatedButton widget that lets you apply linear or other gradients to the button background, customize foreground color, shape, padding, elevation, and disabled state. It also offers a ThemeExtension for consistent styling across the app.
use_when: Need a button with gradient background
Want to theme all gradient buttons via ThemeData.extensions
Require a simple, single-purpose button widget
avoid_when: Building complex button interactions that need custom state management
Using deprecated GradientButtonThemeData in new projects
strengths: Easy to use, themeable via ThemeExtension
Supports disabled gradient and custom styling
weaknesses: Only provides elevated button style, no other button types
No support for other button variants like text or outlined
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import package; no build_runner or permissions required
